items.title: Actual product density in block coordinates (Ex70)

source.anchor: A2.SS2.p2.1 actual density definitions; S3.E4-E6 actual precision/prior/average; A2.SS2.SSS3.p3.1 and A2.Ex70; S3.SS1.p3.2 and A2.SS2.SSS3.p3.3 zero-residual convention. Ex71-72 are downstream.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. Ex70 cites Eq6 for the product density. ASTIS supplies explicit Lebesgue-coordinate and actual-density identification details omitted there.
source.scope: Actual Ex70 density representative in split and ambient coordinates, including the source zero-residual omission. No affinity tensorization or amplified TV credit.

assumptions: \(d,n\in\mathbb N,\ 3\le n\le d,\ \kappa\ge4\), with inclusive endpoints; \(k=\lfloor d/n\rfloor\) and \(r=d-kn=d\bmod n\). Fix one \(b\in\{-1,+1\}\) across all independently drawn blocks.

For normalized Haar probability \(\mu_n\) on the full real orthogonal group, put \(\nu_b=2\mu_n|_{\{\det O=b\}}\). Set \(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\), \(A_{\boldsymbol O}=\operatorname{diag}(A_{O_1},\ldots,A_{O_k},I_r)\), and \(\mathcal D_b=(\boldsymbol O\mapsto A_{\boldsymbol O})_\#\nu_b^{\otimes k}\).

The target is the actual Gaussian mixture \(\bar\pi_b=\int\mathcal N(0,A^{-1})\,d\mathcal D_b(A)\). The single-block law is \(P_b=\int\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\,d\nu_b(O)\). The shared Eq6 and density producers internally establish their probability, Gaussian-domain and measurability facts.

Use the actual precision-density representative \(p_O(x)=\sqrt{\det A_O}(2\pi)^{-n/2}e^{-x^\top A_Ox/2}\) and \(p_b(x)=\int p_O(x)\,d\nu_b(O)\). The existing actual-mixture-density theorem proves every-point inner integrability and the actual law equality; totalized real integration is not used as a fallback. Other source density representatives agree almost everywhere, rather than pointwise.

The split uses zero-based coordinates \((x_j)_i=x_{jn+i}\) and \(z_t=x_{kn+t}\). Ambient Euclidean volume and product block/residual Lebesgue volume are the base measures. Volume preservation and bijectivity are proved; the ordinary Pi maximum norm is not declared isometric to the ambient Euclidean norm.

For \(r>0\), \(\varphi_r(z)=(2\pi)^{-r/2}e^{-\lVert z\rVert^2/2}\) is the printed residual Gaussian density. For \(r=0\), the sole vector has unit Lebesgue mass, the Gaussian is the unit point mass and \(\varphi_0=1\); this realizes the source omitted-factor case. No positive-remainder premise is added.

obligations.label: The actual Gaussian matrix-prior average has the Ex70 product density under the actual volume-preserving split, including the unit residual case.

bindings.boundary: Actual product density, canonical coordinate volume, genuine L1 and mass one only. Ex71 affinity tensorization, Ex72 amplified TV, determinant-sign posterior/transcript/exact-matvec and deterministic worst-case query-cap/TV-precision/expected-cost adapters, fixed-spectrum hidden eigenbasis and both main lower bounds remain open. Local proof, independent verification, integration, remote publication, purification and whole-Goal completion are separate phases.

assumption_deltas.source: Source n>=3,kappa>=4,3<=n<=d and one fixed sign b for the independent block prior.
assumption_deltas.lean: Exactly those bounds and common sign, with k=d/n and r=d%n.
assumption_deltas.reason: Endpoints and source full-Haar conditioning are retained; no oracle-budget specialization is added.

assumption_deltas.source: p_O and p_b are densities of the actual Gaussian and actual single-block mixture; Ex70 is a density of the actual averaged target.
assumption_deltas.lean: Choose the canonical precision-Gaussian formula and actual Haar-average representative, and prove exact withDensity equalities for the actual matrix-prior Gaussian bind.
assumption_deltas.reason: Density representatives are a.e. objects; the existing shared producer supplies inner L1, actual density validity and normalization internally. No arbitrary-representative pointwise claim or totalized-integral fallback is used.

assumption_deltas.source: Euclidean block coordinates and Lebesgue dx are implicit in Ex70.
assumption_deltas.lean: The literal contiguous split is a measurable bijection and preserves canonical ambient/product volumes; both ambient and coordinate density equalities are proved.
assumption_deltas.reason: The unit volume factor is produced, without inferring an isometry for the ordinary Pi maximum norm.

assumption_deltas.source: Ex70 prints the Gaussian factor for kn<d; S3 and the text after Ex71 omit it for kn=d.
assumption_deltas.lean: Use the actual canonical density for all finite residual dimensions, explicitly proving phi=1 at r=0.
assumption_deltas.reason: This realizes the two source cases by a unit zero-dimensional factor. No residual-positive premise, source repair or branch weakening.
